title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: set-up guides, editing, error detail and alerts for connector admins
notes: claim 75: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, error-download script and notification controls are supported. Its assurances that no new data source is added and end users see no change go beyond Microsoft's published description; two documentation disagreements and a checklist omission also need correction.
